title: Zero-Shot Weight-Space Programming Across a Difficulty-Graded Ladder of Two-Player Games
abstract: arXiv:2611.09271v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Weight-space programming sets every weight of a feed-forward network by hand, from an explicit specification of the desired computation, with no gradient descent and no training data anywhere in the construction. We ask how far a large language model can carry this practice, zero-shot, across games of deliberately increasing difficulty. We design a four-rung ladder (Nim, tic-tac-toe, two sizes of Connect Four, and a chess endgame) spanning four axes of difficulty, and build a second, independent network at each rung, using a structurally unrelated game at matched difficulty, to separate what a rung's finding says about the difficulty level from what it says about the one game used to measure it. Ten networks are built and independently verified. Six admit a complete, non-statistical proof of correctness against an independent oracle. translated_title: 跨越双人游戏难度分级阶梯的零样本权重空间编程
translated_abstract: 权重空间编程是指依据对目标计算的显式规范，手工设定前馈网络的每一个权重，整个构造过程中完全不使用梯度下降，也不使用任何训练数据。我们探究大语言模型能否以零样本方式将这一实践推广到难度刻意递增的游戏上。我们设计了一个四级阶梯（尼姆棋、井字棋、两种棋盘尺寸的四子棋以及一个国际象棋残局），涵盖四个难度维度，并在每一级额外构建一个结构上互不相关、难度相当的游戏网络，以区分某一层级的结论究竟反映的是该难度水平本身，还是仅反映用于测量的那一个游戏。共构建了十个网络并进行独立验证，其中六个网络可针对独立预言机给出完整且非统计性的正确性证明。国际象棋残局层级在正确性代价较低的部分（走法合法性，以及其中一个网络中的……）是精确的。（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文首次系统考察大语言模型零样本权重空间编程的能力边界，在涵盖四个难度维度的双人游戏四级阶梯上零样本手工设定前馈网络的全部权重，构建并独立验证了十个网络，其中六个获得完整且非统计性的正确性证明。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that a large language model can zero-shot hand-program every weight of feedforward networks across a four-rung, difficulty-graded ladder of two-player games, yielding ten independently verified networks—six with complete non-statistical proofs of correctness—thereby systematically probing the limits of LLM-driven weight-space programming.
